lines.x: Doctor, the black tea and the refreshments are ready. Is there anything else you'd like me to do?
罗德岛想拓展和太阳谷的合作？联系这个地址可能有用。也准备增加雷姆必拓的矿石采购？这个号码也许帮得上忙。还想更新药物产线？这……这我好像没有什么渠道，我自己现学来得及吗？

Mother always taught me that an elegant lady must mind the neatness of her dress and the poise of her bearing at all times—the mud on my face? And the bits of grass on my sleeve? Ahem. We crawled into a sandbeast's burrow to take shelter from a Catastrophe. It was such a fascinating experience! Would you like to hear about it?
Whew—would you like to run with me, Doctor? I've finished my laps, but I don't want to stop yet. When I'm running, it feels like time itself slows down, as if I'm running out ahead of it!

*Cough, cough.* I've already finished this morning's training. After lunch, I'll go learn rock-climbing technique. Angelina promised that if my health improves a little, she'll take me to the rainforests of Sargon. I have to be faster, I have to try harder—there's still so much I want to do!

This calendar used to be so thin, but now it keeps getting thicker—this page is my notes from studying Originium Arts, this page is a photo from when I delivered letters—it was only ever meant to count down what little time a pitiable patient had left. Now it records what a marvelous life I'm living.

You think the Medical Department gives a lot of instructions? Back home, the moment I stepped out, Father would line the whole route with air purifiers, saying he was afraid it wasn't safe. Mother got so worked up she'd take blood pressure medication. Pfft—compared to my family, everyone in the Medical Department is remarkably understanding.

Tani can't wait to show off her driving, Amelia designed a new vehicle comms console, and Angelina says she can lift the entire vehicle into the air now. We're planning another trip. Would you come along, Doctor? There just happens to be one seat left!

You're saying the comms towers we put up along the way carried a message that successfully gave early warning of a Catastrophe? Doctor, that is truly the best news I've ever heard—not only have I seen so much of the world, now I can even help other people. Th-this is exactly the life I wanted!
Whew—I told you sorting documents isn't all that complicated. Father and Mother never let me do it, but something like this isn't going to tire me out.

Jacinta Campbell, at your service, Doctor. It's a pleasure to meet you. This is a sweet carrot-flavored black tea I brought for you from Rim Billiton. I hope that after a cup, you'll enjoy a day in fine spirits.
Eh! Doctor, look—that's the marsupial musbeast, that's the one that stole our things!
I'm going to tuck this badge into my calendar too. Thanks to my efforts, it's grown thicker again!

Doctor, every single day now is full and happy beyond words. I get to study, to put it into practice, and to help others with my own strength—drink today's health vegetable juice for you? No, no, absolutely not. I couldn't bear it.
At last, a chance to travel through Rim Billiton with everyone. I'll do my best to help!
Thank you all for your trust. I'll be a leader worthy of it.
Let's set out!
Do check your packs—marsupial musbeasts will steal things.
咳咳……没事，只是呛了一下，我跟得上的！
呼、呼……还好出发前做了体能训练……
Shall we try that geyser surfing everyone talks about?
They say you can even swim inside some bottletrees!
嘘，博士，那是只两米高的大钳兽，快别动了躲起来……
嘘——博士，那头牙兽有五米长，别让它发现我们……
嘘————博士，那群针蚤靠近我们了，安静屏住呼吸……
Aaah, please! Stay! Away from me! A lady needs her personal space—
See? I told you—if we're all together, we can absolutely do it!
Doctor, could you take a photo for me? I want to commemorate reaching yet another place I've never been!
噗，我们像是被扔进泥地里滚了一圈一样，不过还挺有趣的，哈哈哈……！
我们的背包真的被有袋鼷兽偷得干干净净呢……
I thought Sun Valley's mobile vessels were big enough, but Rhodes Island is an entire moving landmass.
Oh, is this how people greet each other on Rhodes Island? I see—I'll remember that.
Mm, please don't worry. I've been taking my medication properly and getting treatment on schedule.
Arknights.

(sound of writing) Happy New Year, Doctor. By the time you receive this letter, you should be gathered with everyone at Rhodes Island, celebrating. Big Iron Town is holding its New Year Golden Radish Festival, so I picked out the prettiest one and sent it along with this letter. I hope you like the taste!
I hope you have a pleasant day, Doctor.

Please come with me, Doctor—a birthday-themed afternoon tea is already set out in the garden. Pfft, don't worry, the marsupial musbeasts won't come steal the sweets this time. I prepared a portion for them, too~

Everyone sets an anniversary goal for themselves. I heard Tani quietly add that she'd like to grow just a little taller. Me? My wish is simply for more time—so that every year at this time I can gather with everyone and happily celebrate another year we worked through together.
